verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a hands-on community report that multimodal support in Ollama's new app "works as expected." That points to image-plus-text input in the product itself, but there are no first-party docs on vision-language models. The image-generation blog post covers a different capability and is not credited. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of vision model support, named supported VLMs, API details for passing images alongside text, and independent corroboration beyond a single brief comment.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run vision-language models that understand images alongside text

citations.quote: Multimodal and Markdown support works as expected.
